name: เวียงธารหลิว
heights_info: heights[y][x] = walking-surface height (world Y) at the centre of cell (x, y); blocked cells hold the terrain height. height_origin [0.5, 0.5] tells scripts/shared/map_grid.gd the samples sit on cell centres; it then interpolates between walkable cells only (bridge decks never blend with the riverbed of the water cells beside them)
